title: I spent a month living with a $430 AI pet, the Casio Moflin
description: Casio’s Moflin, a hamster-like robot pet, uses AI to develop a personality over time.
author: Amanda Silberling

title: As the browser wars heat up, here are the hottest alternatives to Chrome and Safari in 2025
description: We’ve compiled an overview of some of the top alternative browsers available today aiming to challenge Chrome and Safari.
author: Lauren Forristal

title: a16z-backed Codi launches AI agent office manager
description: The startup released its beta version of the new AI office management product in May and officially launched it on Tuesday. The company last raised a $16 million Series A in 2022 led by a16z, and has raised $23 million to date.
author: Dominic-Madori Davis

title: OpenAI launches an AI-powered browser: ChatGPT Atlas
description: OpenAI is launching an AI-powered browser, its latest challenge to Google as the main way people find information online.
author: Maxwell Zeff

title: YouTube’s likeness-detection technology has officially launched
description: YouTube’s detection technology identifies and manages AI-generated content featuring the likeness of creators, such as their face and voice.
author: Lauren Forristal

title: WhatsApp and Messenger add new warnings to help older people avoid online scams
description: WhatsApp will now warn users before sharing their screen with unknown contacts, and Messenger will flag suspicious messages using AI.
author: Sarah Perez

title: Serval raises $47M to bring AI agents to IT service management
description: Serval is using agentic AI models to automate IT service management, but the company has a unique approach that takes advantage of agentic AI’s powers while avoiding many of its pitfalls.
author: Russell Brandom

title: Anthropic CEO claps back after Trump officials accuse firm of AI fear-mongering
description: Amodei’s response comes after last week’s dogpiling on Anthropic from AI leaders and top members of the Trump administration, including AI czar David Sacks and White House senior policy advisor for AI Sriram Krishnan -- all accusing the AI giant of stoking fears to damage the industry.
author: Rebecca Bellan

title: The full TechCrunch Disrupt Stage revealed: Where the future of tech breaks first
description: The Disrupt Stage, only at TechCrunch Disrupt 2025, is where tech’s biggest bets get made, live and unfiltered.
author: TechCrunch Events
